description: Approval and evidence policy for the ultimate-game-maker gate engine. It decides which capability action needs a recorded human approval, what counts as usable evidence, and what blocks a gate at each stage.

approval_required_actions.reason: Publishing or signing an artifact is irreversible and reaches players or a store.
approval_required_actions.approval_record: approver name, timestamp, artifact hash, and target channel

approval_required_actions.reason: Money, licensing, or contractual spend cannot be undone by an agent.
approval_required_actions.approval_record: approver name, budget or license reference, and scope

approval_required_actions.reason: Credential and production-data actions can expose users or destroy data.
approval_required_actions.approval_record: approver name, change ticket, and backup reference

approval_required_actions.reason: Destructive or breaking actions can remove work, break ecosystems, or lose provenance.
approval_required_actions.approval_record: approver name, affected paths or APIs, and rollback plan

approval_required_actions.reason: Privileged, policy, or safety actions carry legal and security consequences.
approval_required_actions.approval_record: approver name, policy reference, and expiry date

evidence.notes: A check can only be marked pass with evidence text at or above min_evidence_chars; 'waiver' needs a named approver and a written reason. Anything else is treated as missing.

draft.description: Early work in progress: report only, never block.

milestone.description: Milestone closure: required functional, quality, compatibility, security, and accessibility checks must pass; missing required checks block.

release.description: Release or publish: every required check must pass or carry a named waiver; missing checks always block.
